journey.name: Lift: a density block heard with the screen off
journey.description: A density block (rounds in a time cap) is made in the program editor and run from the session: it counts in, takes a tap a round, and keeps counting and calling the clock while the screen is off, held awake by the timers' service and shown as a Live Update, then says the time and the rounds as the cap ends and lets go. The summary says the rounds. Run with the emulator's volume up, the Voice switch on in Settings, notifications allowed (lift-rest-alert.xml asks).

actions.action: Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength", then "Follow a program", scroll to "New program" and tap it
Tap "Add block", then "Time cap" under "How it runs", and verify that its stepper reads "Minutes" at 5; tap "Done"
Verify that the day's block reads "As many rounds as you can in 5 min · 10 a round"
Name the program "Density", tap "Save program", tap "Density" on the list and then "Follow this program"
Tap "Start day 1" and verify that the session's foot offers "Start the clock" where "Log set" would be
Tap "Start the clock" and verify that the block's screen shows "Get ready", then "Go" with "5 min cap" and "0 rounds"
Tap "Round done" twice and verify that it reads "2 rounds"
Verify with adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact that an ongoing notification titled "Rounds in a time cap" is showing, with PROMOTED_ONGOING among its flags (Android 16+)
Turn the screen off (adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP)
Verify with adb shell dumpsys power that a PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK tagged "interval:timer" is held
Wait until four minutes into the cap and verify that "One minute" was said with the screen off (the emulator's audio, or logcat's TextToSpeech lines)
Wait until the cap ends and verify that its last beeps played and "Time. 2 rounds" was said with the screen off
Wait ten seconds and verify with adb shell dumpsys power that no wake lock tagged "interval:timer" is held, and that the notification is gone
Turn the screen on (adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP), swipe to unlock, and verify that the session shows again with "Extra set" beside "Finish"
Tap "Finish" and verify that the summary shows "2 rounds in 5 min"
